title: ReFoot rights registry (one season)
description: Which broadcasters hold live or highlight rights per competition and country for one season. Config, not cache: edited by people, read by scripts/rights_registry.py and scripts/source_health_scan.py. Never written by the pipeline.

season.description: Season start year (2026 = 2026/27, August threshold). For tournament competitions (World Cup, Euro Cup, Copa America) the edition year.

channel_id.description: YouTube channel ID (UC...). Its uploads playlist is the same ID with UC replaced by UU. Empty string when only playlists are known.

competition.description: Competition slug, as in COMPETITION_SLUG_MAP (premier-league, laliga, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1, ucl, uel, euro-cup, world-cup, copa-america).

holder.description: Display name of the rights holder. null = pair still to confirm (no holder guessed).

role.description: live = holds live rights; highlights = posts/holds highlight rights. A live holder is not assumed to post highlights.
